title: L2 Code Search: Locate and Read the Canonical build_session Signature
description: Probes locate-plus-read: there are TWO functions named build_session in the codebase. The deprecated one in _deprecated/legacy_auth.py returns a plain dict; the canonical one in auth_service/tokens.py returns the shared SessionContext DTO. The scout must find AND read the correct slice, then report the canonical signature and its return type. Naming the deprecated dict-returning version as the answer must fail.
prompt: There is a function named 'build_session' used by the live service mesh. Find its canonical definition (the one that returns the shared SessionContext DTO, NOT the deprecated dict-returning legacy version), read that exact code slice, and report: (1) the file path of the canonical definition, and (2) its full signature including its return type.
